gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.title: MaiMai Dialogue Editor
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.unavailable: This feature is not available yet
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.status: No project open  ·  Validation messages will appear here
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.narrow_window: Widen the window to expand this panel
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.name: Project name
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.names: Namespace uses lowercase letters, digits, _, - and . . Changing it does not move the project folder.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.metad: Name is empty or namespace is invalid. You can still save this unfinished draft.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.confi: This project has unsaved changes. Save before continuing, discard the changes, or cancel to keep editing.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.prope: Edit the name and namespace in the Project dropdown menu. Closing a project does not delete its files.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.new_h: All projects stay in maimai-dialogue-projects in the game folder. Storage folders are assigned automatically. Creating a draft does not write files until Save.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.open_: Projects in maimai-dialogue-projects are listed with the most recently modified first. Click a project to open it.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.list_: No saved projects yet. Create and save a project to see it here.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.ready: Edit project settings in the Project menu; content editing follows later.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.creat: Draft created. Save to write it to disk.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.error: Projects must stay inside maimai-dialogue-projects. Links to external folders are not allowed.
Invalid project file. The current project is unchanged.
This project format version is not supported.
This storage folder is now occupied. Your draft is retained; use Project > Save as to create a copy.
The project storage location is occupied by a file instead of a folder.
The project file was changed or removed outside the editor. Your draft is retained; use Project > Save as to create a copy in the projects folder.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.save_: Enter a name for the copy. A new folder inside maimai-dialogue-projects is assigned automatically. You will continue editing the copy without overwriting the original.
gui.maimai_dialogue_editor.project.error: The project file exceeds the 16 MiB limit.
File operation failed. Check that the project files exist and the storage folder is accessible.
